title: Composition of iterated header tails
statement: For all natural numbers $a,b$ and every finite binary word $w$, taking $a+b$ iterated header tails of $w$ gives the same word as first taking $a$ iterated header tails and then taking $b$ iterated header tails.
replaced: For all counts $a$ and $b$ and every word, following $a + b$ encoded header tails equals following $b$ tails of the result of following $a$ tails.
